items.title: 5.1 Properties of gases (gases ki khasusiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 5.1, printed page 96.

blocks.text: Matter (maddah) chaar states mein milta hai: solid, liquid, gas aur plasma. Matter ki sab se simple shakal gas hai, aur hamare aas paas zyada tar matter solid hai. Liquids, solids, gases aur plasma se kam milte hain. Wajah yeh hai ke kisi bhi cheez ki liquid state sirf temperature aur pressure ki ek tang (narrow) range mein hi reh sakti hai.
Aaiye gases, liquids aur solids ki aam properties (khusoosiyat) dekhein. Gases ki kinetic molecular theory in properties ko samajhne mein madad karti hai.

items: Gas ki koi fixed shakal aur fixed volume nahi hota. Gas ka volume wahi hota hai jo container (bartan) ka volume hai.
Ideal gas ke particles ka apna volume zero mana jata hai.

Gas ke molecules ek doosre se bohat door hote hain aur gas ka taqreeban 99.9% volume khali jagah (empty space) hai. Isi liye gas ko asani se compress kiya (dabaya) ja sakta hai. Jab gas achanak expand hoti (phailti) hai to thandak paida hoti hai; ise Joule-Thomson effect kehte hain.
Gas ka pressure is liye hota hai ke us ke molecules container ki deewaron se collide karte (takrate) hain.
Ideal gas mein intermolecular forces (molecules ke darmiyan attraction) na hone ke barabar hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Teen box: Gas (thore se particles door door bikhre hue), Liquid (particles qareeb qareeb, box ke neeche wale hisse mein) aur Solid (particles regular lines mein jure hue). Har box ke neeche ek chhota label: 'door door, tez harkat', 'qareeb, behte hue', 'regular, sirf vibration'.
blocks.caption: Gas, liquid aur solid mein particles (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Gas mein molecules bohat door hain, to gas apna container bhar deti hai, taqreeban sari khali jagah hai aur asani se compress hoti hai; us ka pressure deewaron par molecules ki takkar hai. Liquid mein molecules touch karte hain magar ek doosre ke paas se guzarte hain, to volume fixed hai, liquid behta aur diffuse hota hai, aur bohat kam compress hota hai. Solid mein particles apni jagah jame hain aur sirf vibrate karte hain. Pressure dugna karne se hawa ka volume aadha ho jata hai magar pani sirf 0.0045 % kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Gas ko ek bare khali kamre ki tarah samjhein jis mein chand log tez tez ghoom rahe hon: jagah zyada, log kam. Isi liye gas dab jati hai, poora container bhar leti hai, aur deewaron se takra kar pressure banati hai. Quick Check 5.1 ke sawal agle topic 5.2 ke aakhir mein hain, kyunke kitab unhen wahin chhapti hai.

items: Matter ki chaar states: solid, liquid, gas, plasma; liquid sirf temperature aur pressure ki tang range mein milta hai.

Gas: fixed shakal ya volume nahi, taqreeban 99.9% khali jagah (asani se compress), pressure deewaron se takrane se, ideal gas mein particle volume zero aur forces na hone ke barabar; achanak phailne par thandak (Joule-Thomson effect).
